title: Chinh sach thue thu nhap ca nhan moi nam 2024: Nhung diem can luu y
content_markdown:
## Tong quan ve thue thu nhap ca nhan

Nam 2024, chinh sach thue thu nhap ca nhan (TNCN) tiep tuc duoc dieu chinh nham dam bao cong bang xa hoi. Theo do, muc giam tru ban than duoc nang len 11 trieu dong/thang, con nguoi phu thuoc la 4,4 trieu dong/thang/nguoi.

## Cac bac thue suat

Bieu thue luy tien tung phan gom 7 bac:
- Bac 1: Thu nhap <= 5 trieu - thue suat 5%
- Bac 2: 5-10 trieu - thue suat 10%
- Bac 3: 10-18 trieu - thue suat 15%
- Bac 4: 18-32 trieu - thue suat 20%
- Bac 5: 32-52 trieu - thue suat 25%
- Bac 6: 52-80 trieu - thue suat 30%
- Bac 7: > 80 trieu - thue suat 35%

## Doi tuong phai nop thue

Tat ca ca nhan co thu nhap tu kinh doanh, tien luong, tien cong tai Viet Nam deu phai nop thue TNCN theo quy dinh cua Luat Thue thu nhap ca nhan.

## Thoi han khai thue

- Khai thue thang: cham nhat ngay 20 thang sau
- Khai thue quy: cham nhat ngay 30 thang dau quy sau
